items.body: Review by siLLy puPPy — Touted as the French female fronted version of Porcupine Tree, the Brittany based DELUSION SQUAREDemerged in 2009 as a band that delivered much more than being a mere Steven Wilson clone. A meretrio with a larger than life sound the band was initiated by bassist / keyboardist Emmanuel de SaintM�en and multi-instrumentalist Steven Francis who would hook up with guitarist and vocalist LorraineYoung and crank out a trilogy of sci-fi themed concept albums that explored all the good BladeRunner-esque dystopia and control systems of power structures. The band released three albums withYoung who would move on before the fourth and final release came out in 2018.The band's self-titled debut and first album of the trilogy delivered an album's worth of mindbending paranoia as it incorporates the story-telling narratives inspired by neo-prog acts such asPendragon, IQ and Arena although the alternative heavy rock guitar does indeed derive inspirationfrom the prog alt rock of Porcupine Tree's early 2000s works. The music while rooted in accessibleinstantly addictive melodies also offers a grunge-fueled guitar heft that gracefully melds theworlds of smooth atmospheric embellishments with a grittier guitar gusto. While the PT referencesget tossed around quite a bit, to my ears the band at this stage reminds me more of an accessiblecrossover version of Thinking Plague if that band had eschewed the jagged angularities of avant-progand focused more on pop hooks.The album of 11 tracks is nicely spanned out with interesting intros that introduces delicate piano-based hooks and tender, even fragile sounding vocals that contrast starkly with the alternative rockon the verge of becoming metal guitar chords and riffing sessions. On the production side the albumis both smoothly polished as well as offering a nice grating edge that keeps it on both sides of thefence simultaneously in a rather elegant fashion. The tracks vary sufficiently to keep the interestlevel up and although the album sounds a little generic with the opening "The Very Day," it doesn'ttake long for its charm to burrow into your psyche and let you acclimate rather quickly into thesubtle differences that point to varying influences but sound distant enough to offer a fresh spinon the more modern take on the alt heavy rock shtick.It's actually a very pleasant mix by merging the worlds of the hard alternative rock of PorcupineTree alone with the narrative layout of neo-prog acts along with the accompanying atmospheric andkeyboard prowess. Both aspects really hold up well and despite being only a trio, the members playmultiple instruments offering a much larger band sound. Add to that the Muse inspired topics ofconspiracy, crimes against humanity and secret projects and it doesn't take long to get sucked intothe mix of it all. While lyrics rarely appeal to me, i have say that DELUSION SQUARED's debutdelivered a nicely balanced album where themes, lyrics, instrumentation and production all cometogether in a unique yet familiar manner and performed quite well by the musicians without losingthat laid back charm even when rocking the house.
items._cn_summary: 这张自命名的处女作是Delusion Squared科幻三部曲的开篇，以三人编制营造出超出规模的声响。吉他手兼主唱Lorraine Young的声线在柔美脆弱与金属化锐利之间切换，键盘与贝斯编织的层次托起叙事结构。专辑融合Porcupine Tree式另类摇滚的吉他重量与新前卫乐派的叙事框架，钢琴主导的引子、grunge式riff与大气音效交替推进。制作兼具光泽与颗粒感，使声音同时保持流畅与粗粝。十一首曲目在阴谋论、反乌托邦等主题下铺陈，歌词文本被纳入整体设计。虽被频繁比作Porcupine Tree，评论者认为其音乐也带有Thinking Plague去除棱角后偏向流行钩子的特质，整体偏可听性而非实验性。

items.body: Cleveland electronic duo She 1 • Him 2 released the single “Obsessed” on September 25, 2026, alongside a music video directed by Steven Sladek from a concept by vocalist Cassie Bishop. The song is inspired by the horror film “Obsession” and its character Nikki, played by Inde Navarrette, and pairs darker lyrics with an upbeat synthpop arrangement. “I wrote the lyrics to this song based off the movie Obsession, which I loved and thought was a unique and fun idea for a horror movie,” Bishop stated. “I wanted to capture some of the elements and mood of the film in this piece.” Evan Nave, the duo’s other half, described the track as a modern take on an 80s sound: “This song has been amazing to put together. An 80s vibe with a very modern spin. And our producer, Michael Seifert, dropped some very Fixx-like guitars on it. Love the dark lyrical tone versus the upbeat music dichotomy.” Seifert, a longtime collaborator of the duo, produced “Obsessed” and played guitar on the track; his other production credits include Tori Amos, Paul Simon, Regina Spektor, Fountains of Wayne and Snarky Puppy. “Obsessed” is available now on all digital and streaming platforms. About She 1 • Him 2 She 1 • Him 2 are Evan Nave and Cassie Bishop, an electronic duo from Northeast Ohio who draw on classic synthpop, new wave and darker electronic influences. The pair came together from the projects Lestat and Shy Moon. items.body: German synth duo Felsmann + Tiley released “Reinterpretations #1” on Mute on 24 September 2026. The four-track EP is the first of three planned installments of “Protomensch (Deluxe),” a reworked version of the duo’s 2026 album “Protomensch,” built from new versions of the album’s songs by outside producers. “Reinterpretations #1” collects “Open Fields (Silver Panda Remix),” “God Is Lonelier (Echonomist Remix),” “Always You (Sensu Remix)” and “Warum (Lysten Remix).” Two of the four, the Echonomist and Sensu remixes, had already come out as individual tracks earlier in 2026. The Silver Panda and Lysten versions are new to this release. The EP is out digitally through Bandcamp and on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Tidal, Qobuz, Deezer and Amazon Music, with Beatport carrying it for purchase. Dominik Felsmann and Patrick Tiley describe the EP as a deliberate return to the dance-floor material they made before Felsmann + Tiley became a synth-only project. “We started out as electronic dance music producers and DJs, and that history doesn’t disappear just because we’re now limiting ourselves to synth-only compositions. For this remix EP, we specifically invited three artists to bring the drums back. The result is a reminder that our former DNA still runs through even the most stripped-back version of a song, and that adding drums back in can reveal as much about the original as removing them did.” Open Fields (Silver Panda Remix) by Felsmann + Tiley The ‘Reinterpretations #1’ tracklist “Open Fields” (Silver Panda Remix) “God Is Lonelier” (Echonomist Remix) “Always You” (Sensu Remix) “Warum” (Lysten Remix) Melodic house duo Silver Panda opens the EP with a version of “Open Fields” that starts on vocals before a four-on-the-floor beat enters and carries the track’s melody into a club arrangement. Greek melodic techno producer Echonomist reworks “God Is Lonelier” into a slower, more minimal arrangement that builds gradually over its running time. Swiss producer Sensu’s version of “Always You” runs on processed vocals, layered synths and a continuous beat. French producer Lysten closes the EP with “Warum” at a reduced tempo, the slowest of the four tracks. Echonomist’s remix, released on its own on 3 September 2026, was recorded largely on the road: the producer finished most of the mix in a friend’s studio in Los Angeles while touring the US and Mexico. Sensu’s remix of “Always You” first came out as a single on 23 July 2026. Live dates and the ‘Gabriel’ A24 sync Felsmann + Tiley have two live dates in November, at the Purcell Room, Southbank Centre, in London and at Kantine am Berghain in Berlin. Side-Line first reported both dates alongside the Echonomist remix on 3 September 2026. They remain the duo’s only announced shows. 22 November 2026 – London, UK – Purcell Room, Southbank Centre, tickets from £33 25 November 2026 – Berlin, DE – Kantine am Berghain, tickets from €28 Separately, the “Protomensch” track “Gabriel” features on the trailer for “You Can See Everything,” the A24 documentary on Elizabeth Holmes directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim. The film’s trailer went out in the same week as “Reinterpretations #1.” Two more ‘Reinterpretations’ EPs to come Reinterpretations #2 arrives on 22 October with reworks of “Memory,” “Reset” and “Open Fields” by Meredi, Sofi Paez and Lambert. A standalone single, Jamie Irrepressible’s version of “Seeker,” follows before Reinterpretations #3 closes the series on 20 November with Meredi’s “Memory,” Jamie Irrepressible’s “Seeker” and a studio session version of “Open Fields.” About Felsmann + Tiley Dominik Felsmann and Patrick Tiley met in 2003 on the German music production forum MyOwnMusic.de and found they shared a hometown, Stuttgart. Their first release together came out under the alias Kamui, the 12-inch “Ghosts,” followed by releases under further aliases including Ka, Monsun, Synthflut, Virus Inc. and Black Phaze, all built around club-oriented electronic music. The pair moved toward reinterpreting other artists’ songs, and two of those reworks reached television placements: their version of The Irrepressibles’ “The Most Beautiful Boy” became the lead track for the second season of the Netflix series “Young Royals,” and their reworking of M83‘s “Solitude” appeared on the British crime series “Top Boy.” Both tracks were later released through Mute and Deutsche Grammophon and have reached more than 200 million combined streams. Music supervisor Michel Gaubert included their music in a runway set for Acne Studios, and the late Andrew Weatherall featured the duo on his NTS Radio show. Felsmann + Tiley signed to Mute and released the track “Warum” in June 2025. Their Mute debut album, “Protomensch,” came out on 13 February 2026, its twelve tracks pairing the duo’s synth-only, largely drum-free production with guest vocalists Pet Deaths, The Kite String Tangle, Woodes and Laius. Side-Line covered the album’s rollout, including the video for “Always You” featuring Woodes in February 2026. Since the album’s release, Felsmann + Tiley have issued a run of guest reworks of its songs under the “Protomensch (Deluxe)” banner, of which “Reinterpretations #1” is the first compiled installment. The two further EPs due in October and November, together with the November live dates in London and Berlin, extend that same rollout through the end of 2026.

items.body: The Actions, a Bristol alt-electronic duo, released the single and video “Container” on 25 September 2026 through the Barcelona label No Where Records. The track is the first single from an album the duo have set for spring 2027, following their March 2026 single “Take More.” “Container” is also available to stream on Spotify. ‘Container’ marks The Actions’ first single since ‘Take More’ No Where Records describes “Container” as pushing the duo’s blend of “alternative electronics, dark textures and powerful songwriting” further than their previous single. The Actions describe themselves as an alt-electro-noise duo, and their recent work blends rock and electronic music with a punk-like directness, a shift they trace back to the March 2026 single “Take More.” About The Actions The Actions are a Bristol duo made up of Marta Argenio, who also performs as Silty, and Maurizio “Mo” Stellato. The pair share vocal, guitar and bass duties alongside electronics, exploring the space between rock and electronic music. Their debut album, “Flourish,” came out in 2021. The duo have previously opened for R.E.M., Green Day, Garbage and The Distillers, and earned airplay on BBC Radio 6 Music. The Actions returned in March 2026 with “Take More,” a three-track single pairing the original with a stripped-back “Flatland Mix” and a remix from IKO Twins, backed by a music video Mo edited through his own MStar Design work. The band said the record marked a turn toward something stronger and more direct than their earlier, more atmospheric work: “After our last, more transcendent record, we felt the urge to return with something stronger and more direct, and though it took time to get there, we knew this was the right moment to come back.” They called it “a song about growing up in the suburbs,” weighing whether to stay with the people they love or break away. The Actions joined No Where Records in July 2026. “Container” is the duo’s first release for the Barcelona label and the opening single from the album they have scheduled for spring 2027.
items._cn_summary: The Actions 是来自布里斯托尔的二人组合，成员 Marta Argenio 与 Maurizio Stellato 自 2021 年首张专辑以来持续在摇滚与电子之间探索。"Container" 是 2027 年春季专辑的首支单曲，延续了 2026 年三月单曲 "Take More" 所确立的方向——从此前偏氛围化的作品转向更直接、更有力度的表达，融合另类电子、暗黑质感与朋克式的直白。乐队共享主唱、吉他、贝斯与电子音色，曾为 R.E.M.、Green Day、Garbage 及 The Distillers 暖场，并获得 BBC Radio 6 Music 播出。此次发行也是他们加入巴塞罗那独立厂牌 No Where Records 后的首次亮相。"Take More" 的配套单曲还收录了精简版 Flatland Mix 与 IKO Twins  remix，整体呈现一支独立乐队在风格上的主动收拢与再出发。

items.body: Review by brainsuccasurgery — Fuchs is, above all, Hans-J�rgen and Ines, partners both on stage and off. The couple had already collaborated under the name "Ines" in the 2000s, releasing four captivating albums in which the young Ines Fuchs took the lead as keyboardist and composed nearly all of the tracks. With the launch of the Fuchs project about ten years ago, the roles reversed, bringing Hans and his guitars to the forefront with a more prominent role in the songwriting. But make no mistake: the role of his partner, Ines, remains essential. This is especially true on the album *Too Much Too Many*, their fourth to be released under the name Fuchs, where the balance between their respective contributions seems to be at its best.From the flamboyant "opening track" of the band's first album, *Ines* (Hunting The Fox ? 1994), to the irresistible "How I Wish That You Would"?sweetly sung by In�s Fuchs herself?which closed *Slipping Into The Unknown* eight years later, the flamboyant style of Genesis took center stage, as well as the neo-prog of IQ or Asgard (each album, incidentally, featuring members of that brilliant Italian band), but with a softer, more feminine touch provided by In�s's particularly sensual keyboards, her enchanting harmonies, and her warm, instantly recognizable solos?deeply inspired by those of Tony Banks.On Fuchs' albums, these musical influences seem to have been more fully assimilated and reimagined, to the point where *Too Much Too Many* opens with "Don't Get Me Wrong"?a stunning example of neo-prog, solid and well-grounded, enhanced by beautiful vocal harmonies. The influence of Genesis at its best is still evident throughout the album, particularly on "Once Again" and its sublime synth solo, but overall, *Too Much Too Many* presents a more personal and varied form of symphonic prog?without any jarring surprises, yet one that consistently provides a sense of well-being for the listener. The album alternates between deep, melancholic tracks, with pastel tones drifting on a gentle evening breeze ("Of Hopes And Dreams And Bitter Tears"), others with brighter colors that seem to gush from a warm spring ("Challenge of Lifelong Learning"), arrangements that are constantly in motion ("The Middle Years"), harmonies as beautiful as stars that seem to light up one by one in the sky ("My Life"), and supremely successful melodies, such as on the superbly epic progressive track "Here in My Void " (12:18)?the album's undisputed highlight, which evokes both the Camel of the nineties and the most melancholic RPWL, and in which every note, however varied in form and appeal, seems to surge powerfully in the same direction, straight toward the goal of auditory pleasure. In an era when sanitized pop sells by the millions and is viewed by the billions on YouTube, it's reassuring to know that music as profound, rich, and sincere as Fuchs's continues to exist?more alive than ever with *Too Much Too Many*, a work boldly crafted with passion and talent to better embrace under-explored facets of the soul.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是德国夫妻搭档Hans-Jürgen与Ines以Fuchs名义发布的第四张作品。在他们的早期项目中，Ines作为键盘手主导创作，而现在则以Hans的吉他为核心，Ines的键盘与和声为辅助支撑。整张专辑延续了Genesis、IQ、Asgard等乐队的影响，尤其保留了Tony Banks式的键盘独奏质感，同时融入更为柔和的女性化音色表达。曲目在深沉忧郁与明亮温暖之间交替，编曲层次丰富，包含长达十二分钟的史诗级长篇作品作为亮点。整体属于跨界前卫摇滚范畴，旋律流畅、结构完整，但风格相对传统，偏向主流前卫摇滚表达，与实验性、前卫探索或电子融合路线距离较远。

items.body: The funk Isaac Hayes and Willie Hutch wrote for American crime films in the early 1970s has a second home in Hamburg, a city whose funk scene runs through The Mighty Mocambos, Bacao Rhythm & Steel Band and the Légère Recordings label. The Winston Brothers come straight out of that scene, and “Get On Down” opens their second album, Sweets, out on 6 November via Ohio’s Colemine Records. It starts at full tempo: a hard breakbeat, choppy guitar chanks and a two-man horn section. Multi-instrumentalist and producer Sebastian Nagel and drummer Lucas Kochbeck formed the band as a school project, and Nagel describes the partnership in one line: “It’s a family thing, and we really know each other well.” Both play in Bacao, Nagel has also played with the Mocambos, and Kochbeck with Hamburg Spinners, part of a circuit where the same players keep turning up in each other’s line-ups. Sweets draws on that circuit, with Kimo Eiserbeck on saxophone and flute, Hans Stephan on trumpet and Carsten Meyer, the Hamburg keyboardist known as Erobique, on synths. Extra drums come from Max Weissenfeldt, once of Munich’s The Poets of Rhythm and now working as Max Whitefield. Sax and trumpet stick to short, angular stabs, the punctuating role horns play on the Hayes and Hutch scores. Midway the band drop into a dub-style section with delay on the instrumental parts, and the drums carry on underneath: like Drift, their 2022 debut, the track is built on the break. Stream “Get On Down” HERE and order Sweets ahead of release through THIS LINK The post Daily Discovery: The Winston Brothers – Get On Down appeared first on Rhythm Passport.
items._cn_summary: 本文介绍了汉堡放克乐队The Winston Brothers即将发行的第二张专辑Sweets中的主打曲目Get On Down。乐队核心由多乐器演奏者兼制作人Sebastian Nagel与鼓手Lucas Kochbeck组成，二人均为学校项目的延续，并活跃于汉堡放克圈层，参与过Bacao Rhythm & Steel Band及The Mighty Mocambos等项目。专辑邀来多位圈内乐手参与，包括萨克斯与长号、短笛的铜管组合，以及Erobique担任键盘演奏。制作以七十年代Isaac Hayes与Willie Hutch犯罪电影配乐为参照，硬派breakbeat节奏、棱角分明的铜管短句与dub式的延迟处理段落构成作品骨架，延续了乐队2022年首张专辑Drift的breakbeat路线。

items.body: Review by VianaProghead — Review N� 989The British prog band Karnataka was formed in Swansea, Wales, in 1997. It's one of the leading names in British contemporary progressive rock, despite some intermittency. It was disbanded in 2004, reformed in 2005, suspended in 2017 and returned in 2023. Their sound is known for fusing classic progressive rock with influences from Celtic music, folk, and symphonic atmospheres, often standing out for powerful female vocals and accessible melodies. One of its founding members, Ian Jones, is the only remaining member in the band. The name "Karnataka" was chosen after Jones' trip to India. Karnataka released six studio works, "Karnataka" in 1998, "The Storm" in 2000, "Delicate Flame Of Desire" in 2003, "The Gathering Light" in 2010, "Secrets Of Angels" in 2015 and this one "Requiem For A Dream"."Requiem For A Dream" is Karnataka's most ambitious work to date. At almost 80 minutes long, it marks the band's return after an eight-year hiatus. Lirically, it's a concept album exploring personal adversity and global chaos. It strongly addresses the climate changes and the destruction of the planet. The lyrics balance the despair and loss with a persistent search for hope and a "new beginning" for all humanity. Musically, the album alternates between epic tracks with multiple variations in themes, tones and even modes, and more concise pieces. As a concept album, it's best enjoyed in one sitting and, despite its 79 minutes, it never becomes tedious. It presents a great luxurious production.So, "Requiem For A Dream" is the sixth studio album of Karnataka that was released in 2023. The line up on the album is Sertari (vocals, backing vocals and choir) and Ian Jones (bass guitar, bass pedal, keyboards, piano and acoustic guitar). "Requiem For A Dream" had also the participation of Luke Machin (guitars), Gonzalo Carrera (keyboards), Troy Donockley (uilleann pipes and low whistles) and Chris Allan (drums and percussion), all as guest musicians.The album begins and ends with the whispered words "tick-tock". "All Around The World" captures our attention with its subtle mood. It features a beautifully vocal line. The verses and chorus flow seamlessly into each other with a touch of levity and grace. It has stunning guitar solo work. It's one of its longest tracks. "Sacrifice" has a distinctive character. It allows you to lose yourself in a dreamlike state, swaying your senses with an ethereal sound that leaves an intimate aftertaste. Here, Sartori displays her wide variety of vocal skills. This is a luminous track with transparent orchestration. "Look To The East" combines a hit song with a touch of oriental harmonies. The vocals have a subtle radiance and lightness. It's a well-produced piece with some good vocal effects, sumptuous synths and programming. It has quite a commercial impact upon the ears. "Forgiven" is the second lengthy track. It's an illuminated fabulous ballad, polished and effective in every detail with a spiritual vibe surrounding it with its Latin chanting. It's elevated by an amazing vocal performance from Sartori. It's one of my favorite tracks on the album, a real great work that by itself is worth the album. "The Night's Dance" has a vaporous elegance that offers another triumphantly gorgeous melodic line. It's a lush track with a very beautiful melody, beautifully sung, alongside great orchestration. It's pretty straight ahead, but it does not need to be complicated, as Sertari is the star here. "Say Goodbye Tomorrow" is an up-tempo number with a great guitar work and synth touches in the middle. It's another breath of lightness in the form of a casual track. It's a hopeful and positive song, expressed forcefully via strong voice and a stunning chorus. "Don't Forget My Name" is another ballad, but with a melancholic touch. It's emotional, with tight playing, sensorial impact and meaningful music. Sertari shines amidst frantic guitar struts, pulsating drum rolls, and accompaniment buried deep in the background. The title track is the third longest, the lengthiest, a twenty-five-minute epic. During the running time of the piece, all those ingredients that make Karnataka a melodic prog institution are up front and centre. There are some heavy passages, but above all, there is some more of the pop/prog fusion the band have always done so well. And the orchestration is again well done. It seals, probably, the most mature production in the band's canon releases. This is another track likely to become an onstage favourite. So, to conclude, this is an amazing perfect ending to the album where the lengthy tracks are the best.Conclusion: "Requiem For A Dream" is another great album from this Welsh band. They have never disappointed me, and again they deliver another flawlessly work, indeed. Like a true craftsman, Jones has once again created a piece that deserves to be heard by all those for whom progressive rock is above all a source of pleasure and emotion. They are 80 minutes of melodic adventure of the very finest quality. All things that epitomise Karnataka are captured on this album: ambitious songs, great playing, intelligent lyrics, beautiful symphonic sounds, lovely female voice and fine guitar work. The attention to detail is staggering, which helps to keep things fresh with repeated listenings. This is a band and an album that deserves to be better known. Fans of progressive and symphonic music owe it to themselves to give it a go.Prog is my Ferrari. Jem Godfrey (Frost*

items._cn_summary: Karnataka 乐队成立于1997年威尔士，其第六张录音室专辑《Requiem For A Dream》是八年沉寂后的回归之作。整张专辑时长近80分钟，以概念专辑形式探讨个人困境与全球危机，尤其聚焦气候变化与地球毁灭主题，歌词在绝望中寻求希望与新开始。音乐上，作品在史诗长曲与精炼短曲之间交替，涵盖多样的主题、调性与情绪转换，制作精良饱满。编曲融合了古典前摇滚骨架、凯尔特民谣元素与交响化氛围铺陈，配以强劲的女声主唱、浓郁的合成器织体、东方和声的点缀，以及爱尔兰肘风笛与低音哨等特色乐器的运用。专辑以"tick-tock"的低语首尾呼应，吉他独奏段落技艺精湛。但整体而言，该作品仍属于较为模式化的主流前摇滚范畴，以可听性与旋律优美见长，在实验性、先锋性或声音设计层面的探索较为有限。

items.body: Review by kenethlevine — The passage of 30 years and a (duh, this is Polish neo prog after all) different vocalist notwithstanding, this reminds me of COLLAGE's classic "Moonshine" album, the one that still dwarfs most of the British giants. The problem is, it recalls the excesses of that masterpiece rather than its massive triumphs that inspired so much more from that country and beyond. Apparently conceived to lighten the mood amongst the lyrically downbeat sentiments of the reunion album "Over and Out" and to accompany it on the tour, "One and Only" should have been patterned after the sumptuous "Living in the Moonlight" rather than the bloated "In Your Eyes", which indeed means it's pretty good for the first half and abysmal for the home stretch. In the end, for a presumably lighter number, it's one of their most oppressive songs and I'd rather bathe in the tears of "What about the Pain (a family album)" a thousand times before I hear this again.
items._cn_summary: 这篇乐评讨论了波兰新前卫摇滚乐队COLLAGE三十年后推出的单曲《One and Only》。评论者认为这首歌虽承袭乐队经典专辑《Moonshine》的气质，但更多延续了该作的冗长膨胀之弊，而非其恢弘磅礴之处。原意为配合重聚专辑《Over and Out》巡演而创作的轻快曲目，实际成品却成为乐队最为压抑的作品之一。评论者将歌曲前半段评价为尚可，后半段则形容为糟糕，并表示宁愿反复聆听家庭专辑《What about the Pain》也不愿再听此曲。整体而言，这是一首意图轻松却效果沉重的单曲，与其轻量级定位形成明显反差。

items.body: Review by alainPP — Kimmo P'RSTI's fourth album is a symphonic folk-prog-country affair featuring inspiring guest appearances, an analog sound, and Kimmo battling AI. His style ranges from Genesis and Yes to Supertramp, Camel, and Caravan."Circle of Wagons" showcases a distinctive folk-prog universe, a medieval touch in neo-classical mode, and a solemn sound reminiscent of Camel'it's a given. The choir, the melody that evokes Unitopia, the Archangel, and the cinematic drift on the famous "Close Encounters of the Third Kind" are all present. The guitar solo adds a touch of nostalgia to the repetitive melody, and the outro flute hints at the arrival of the alien. "Carousel" features fruity guitar, swirling keyboards, and a vintage instrumental that flirts with the "dinosaur" aesthetic, a tribute to JP Boffo. "Nightmares Come to Consume" features a fruity and catchy saxophone riff, reminiscent of PANZERPAPPA, but with a touch more Phil COLLINS. The shunt is a highlight, while the chorus becomes repetitive. "Chasing Echoes" has an airy, western-tinged melancholy feel, with a melting intro that perfectly captures the current mood. The vintage organ amplifies the effect of this beautiful, plaintive ballad, with vocals provided by one of the four regular members on this otherwise conventional track. "Things Not Seen" has the sound of a CAMEL album; Risto's saxophone brightens the air, the symphonic keyboard drift flirts with TANGERINE DREAM, followed by a blazing guitar solo and a prominent bassline that grabs your attention. The track is a versatile, danceable pop gem."In My Life" follows in the same vein, with a guitar solo and a raspy vocal that amplify the depth of this AMBROSIA track. "Light of Other Days" opens with a 100% bucolic feel, featuring an enchanting marshmallow flute followed by a devastating pad. The mysterious keyboard draws the listener in; the perfect instrumental that takes you on a journey of no return. "You and the Sun" begins with a jazzy keyboard, followed by a dynamic atmosphere with a prog-metal riff. The vocals of one of the four guests might surprise with their diversity, their distinctiveness, I mean. The mid-track shift evokes "Canterbury" sounds, reminiscent of CARAVAN, with this delicate, understated, soulless yet meticulously crafted variation. "Over the Sleeping Stars" begins with a vibrant bassline and rhythmic percussion on Risto's saxophone. The guitar leads into a fresh, energetic, and catchy instrumental. A festive folk-jazzy vibe at the start, the guitar solo ignites the music; simple, effective, the outro too short to send you soaring into space. "Only One in the Crowd" is a jazz-rock track featuring bass and distinctive keyboards; the vocals add a prog edge. You have to wait for the transitions to truly appreciate the progressive influences, particularly the delicate keyboard solo. The brooding vocals lead into a bluesy guitar solo that we adore, the high notes keeping us on the edge of our seats. This is the album's highlight, showcasing masterful playing. "With a Breath, I Linger" begins with a pastoral flute over a minimalist piano chord. A slow, solemn, almost martial melody, with Hanna and Rafael at the helm, is the perfect way to close this album of concentrated musical notes.Kimmo P'RSTI is the same artist who played in SAMURAI OF PROG, THE GUILDMASTER, and also contributed to Rafael PACHA.

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑属于交响民谣前卫摇滚范畴，融合了七十年代英国前卫摇滚的多种元素。评论提到音乐跨越从 Genesis、Yes 到 Camel、Caravan 的风格光谱，加入了乡村音乐和电影配乐的影响。整张专辑以模拟音色为基础，多首曲目包含合唱编排、管风琴铺垫、萨克斯独奏与吉他solo等传统前卫摇滚手法。曲目结构多为完整歌曲形式，配有旋律性强的合唱段落与器乐过渡。专辑试图通过复古音色和大量客串乐手来营造一种怀旧的交响民谣氛围，但在声音设计的实验性上较为有限，与用户关注的实验前卫、自由即兴或电子融合等方向存在明显距离。整体呈现的是较为传统的前卫摇滚复兴路线。

items.body:
Live at Rockpalast 1999
documents a command performance at the Loreley open-air amphitheater by Malcolm �Mac� Rebennack Jr., aka Dr. John. Rockpalast is a live-music TV show broadcast since 1974 by Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR), the archival source for this CD-DVD package, and coincidentally a remarkable cultural institution on its own terms.
Taped at the height of Dr. John�s international popularity, backing the singer-pianist-guitarist are New Orleans stalwarts Bobby Broom (guitar), David Barard (bass), and Herman Ernest (drums), a tight quartet that projects authority and engages the crowd from start to close.
A striking UNESCO-designated World Heritage Site set, the Loreley is a slate pinnacle on a mythic horseshoe bend of the Rhine River, memorializing an enduring German literary legend both tragic and romantic. The setting is thus well-suited for Mac�s mystical spirit and lyrical style. By this stage of his career, he characterized his live show as a Mardi Gras revue with a mix of New Orleans standards and some of his most recognizable compositions.
Hence, he opens with the NOLA classic �Iko, Iko,� a half-sung, half-chanted celebration of community participation in the renowned Mardi Gras second-line street procession. Then comes the in-your-face boast �Qualified,� wherein the singer warns, �I got the power to control / I can see clean through you, blind mole / I want to tell you now, I'm qualified / You know that I'm qualified.�
Any Dr. John fan will recognize �I Walk on Guilded Splinters,� a moody, percussively insistent, foreboding expression of the Night Tripper�s immersion in �funknology� (his term), gris-gris herbology, and hoodoo incantation, punctuated with jungle growls and cries, a loopy, spooky slide whistle, and an extended psych-guitar solo: �Walk thru the fire / Fly thru the smoke / See my enemy / At the end of dey rope.�
Every piece in this well- honed set deserves considertion. Although Dr John lived for many years in Los Angeles and New York, his enduring hometown connection shows in the fond inclusion of his own �Sweet Home New Orleans� and �Goin� Back to New Orleans,� and he nods to a key influence with a funky rendering of Duke Ellington�s �I'm Gonna Go Fishin�.� Among other gems are Mac�s Top�10 hit �Right Place, Wrong Time,� and the instantly recognizable closer, Earl King�s �Big Chief,� another Mardi Gras burner.
Regarding his live performance approach, per the notes, �I always play a little bit of everything. I think that�s what music�s about: a little bit of somethin� old, somethin� in the middle, somethin� new, and somethin� as yet uncreated.�
Dr John's�s longtime fans will welcome this archival gem, which also is a solid introduction for any late comers to the party. Surmounting the barriers of language and culture, the power of
At the Rockpalast
is also evident in the enthusiastic audience response. As he declares, �If you�re gonna get off on somethin� you don�t need to know nothin� about it. Music is a universal language.�

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑记录了Dr. John 1999年在德国洛雷莱露天剧场的现场演出，背景乐队由新奥尔良老将组成，整体呈现一场Mardi Gras风格的音乐回顾。曲目以新奥尔良经典为主，包括《Iko, Iko》和《I Walk on Guilded Splinters》，后者带有迷幻funk与巫毒仪式化的色彩，滑管、丛林嘶吼与迷幻吉他solo交织。演出还涵盖他自己的代表作如《Right Place, Wrong Time》《Sweet Home New Orleans》，以及对Duke Ellington的funky演绎。作为WDR Rockpalast系列的一部分，发行兼具档案价值，但整体风格属于传统的新奥尔良R&B与funk范畴，融合度有限，与实验、前卫或电子音乐的距离较远。
